Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese name of this Station alludes to Bride's Pool, a small river in Hong Kong.
  • Sidings Exist at the sides of each track in a manner similar to Pisces Pond Station.
  • The name of this station originates from the fact that a Parkour Track used to exist at where this station currently is. The Parkour tracaks have since been demolished.[2]
  • To correspond to the name of this station, a "Stomachache Queue Jumper" is set up near the Los Sengas Coffee of this station. As a result, this Station is the second station after Peanut Island Station to feature a "Stomachache Queue Jumper".
  • This Station is sister stations with Chosen Surge Station.

History[]

  • June 21 2021: This station began services.

2022[]

  • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Phoenix Line Candor Plains Station began operations, but as Phoenix Linehave yet to begin development, Phoenix Line did not extend to Candor Plains Station.
  • All NR Dex have been created.

2024[]

  • Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Wai Kam and Siu Kam.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built to commemorate the fact a groupmate of the Railway Builder named "Justin" was late for a meeting and claimed that he was in Austin Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[3]
  • The two concourses of this station are separated by a road. River Rendezvous Station and Charm River Station also shares a similar concourse design, except that, instead of a road, the concourses of these two stations are separated by a river.

History[]

  • November 28 2016: Plans are in place to build this station.[4]
  • December 5 2016: This station began services alongside New Edward Line.
  • March 27 2018: The Abyss Line part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, this station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.
  • April 7 2018: Abyss Line extends from Dusty Station to this station.

It may also refer to Kaifong Associations that emerged in Hong Kong after the Second World War and involved neighbourhoods helping each other.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 0
  • Find a gantry crane that is vertically opposite to a golden gantry-shaped structure on the rooftop of the station.
  • Jump across barriers and run across the rooftop until you reach the souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of Golden Leggings.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was built to commemorate the completion of West Ring Line and the Kaling Channel Terminal of the Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals. However, this station was not a planned station of Season 1, Episode 15.[3]
  • While the arrival of Lima Line to this station was never officially announced, spoilers for the route of Lima Line after Old Brightland were already seen seen at the Pegasus Line, Lima Line Station Control Room prior to its establishment.

History[]

  • October 3 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • December 23 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works. At the same day, Exit E is added to this station to connect to the Metro Express Transport station of the Same Name. [5]
  • February 26 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • August 12 2024: This station began expansion of the Lima Line Part.
  • August 13 2024: This station completed expansion.[6]
  • August 14 2024: Lima Line extends from Old Brightland Checkpoint to this station. Lima Line is established.

Kaling Channel Station is a station on Leanpool Line. It is operated by Metro Express Transport, and is located at Los Sengas Downtown. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Lima Line (Kaling Channel Station).
